release_notes: 4MP solar-powered 4G bullet kit with Smart Hybrid Light, active strobe + audio deterrence and two-way audio. Documented from the /C36S80 config bundle (80 W panel + 360 Wh battery). Weight/dimension are the assembled solar kit. No specific anti-corrosion protection.
